

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(ggplot2)
library(gapminder)
library(plotly)

```



```{r}
res <- read_csv('../experiments/lassoCV_x_AVG_all.csv')
res
```






```{r}
p <- ggplot(res, aes(y=lassoCV_R2, x=R2, color=Source, text=Dataset)) + 
  scale_color_manual(values=c("viral"= "#D55E00", "cellular"="#0072B2")) + 
  geom_point() + 
  #geom_smooth(method='lm', se=TRUE, alpha=.2) + 
  theme_bw(11) + 
  geom_abline(intercept=0, alpha=0.5, linetype='dashed') + 
  # theme(
  #      legend_position='top',
  #      legend_text=element_text(size=11),
  #      legend_title=element_blank()
  #  ) +
  facet_wrap('~Model', scales='fixed')  + 
  xlim(-0.37, 0.9) + 
  ylim(-0.37, 0.9)+ 
  labs(
        y="R^2 LassoCV",
        x="R^2 AVG Model"
    )

ggplotly(p)
```
